jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Billing & Marketplaces
jobs.description: ClickHouse Cloud, the fully managed version of the open source ClickHouse database, is available on AWS, GCP, and Azure. Customers can purchase directly from ClickHouse or through the cloud marketplaces. Billing is how every ClickHouse product reaches customers and shows up in our financials. As we add new products and new ways to buy, we are investing in our billing platform to scale with them. As Principal Product Manager for Billing and Marketplaces, you will lead that work and report to the Director of Product Management, Billing and Marketplaces. What You Will Do • Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for billing, from usage metering through invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition, working alongside the product managers and engineering leads of our metering and pricing, billing platform, and payments teams. • Evolve our metering and pricing foundation into a single metrics pipeline that new products can reuse, where the same metric can be priced differently by product and tier, and only net-new metrics need code changes. • Evolve our prepaid commit capabilities, with flexibility for customer-specific rate cards or metric-level discounts, contract changes and rollovers, and customer-facing balance visibility and spend alerts. • Own our cloud marketplace strategy and integrations across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including private offers, usage reporting, and subscription linking. • Lead the evaluation of billing architecture, from build versus buy decisions and POCs through migration plans and a clear recommendation to senior leadership. • Give Finance, Data, and Sales Ops systems they can trust, including ERP and revenue recognition sync, period close, audit controls, and SOX and SOC 2 readiness. • Partner with product teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and Support to launch billing for new products and pricing models, and serve as the company's subject matter expert on how customers are billed. • Mentor other product managers and help build the team. About You • 10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years owning billing, metering, payments, or commercial platforms for a cloud or usage-based product. • Deep expertise in usage-based pricing, prepaid credits, and committed spend contracts, and in how they translate into systems, invoices, and revenue. • Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure marketplaces, including private offers, co-sell, entitlements, metering APIs, and disbursements. • Familiarity with payments across card, invoice, marketplace, and partner channels, including dunning and delinquency flows, fraud detection, and payment notifications. • Strong understanding of order-to-cash, including invoicing, payment processing, tax, multi-currency, ERP integration, and revenue recognition. • Experience with third-party billing and payment platforms, such as Stripe or a usage-based billing vendor. • A track record of designing and maturing a product area from v1 and leading complex programs across engineering, Finance, and go-to-market teams. • Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting trade-offs to executives and explaining billing concepts to non-technical audiences. Bonus Points • Experience at an infrastructure, database, or developer platform company. • Comfortable going deep with engineers on event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and idempotency, and fluent enough in SQL to analyze billing data yourself. • Speaking or published thought leadership on usage-based pricing, billing, or cloud marketplaces. Perks • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries. • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. • Global Gather

jobs.description: About AlphaSense: AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us. About the Team: The Financial Data team at AlphaSense is responsible for delivering the data foundation that powers our industry-leading market intelligence platform. We focus on sourcing, integrating, and surfacing structured datasets that enable clients to discover and act on insights in new ways. Our team is dedicated to delivering these datasets directly into our clients' most critical workflows. About the Role: We are seeking a Product Manager to own and define the next generation of our financial data offerings, with a specific emphasis on Private Markets, including Shareholder + Deals content. In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of our vast financial datasets and the end-user's core research and diligence workflows. You will drive the roadmap for how users discover, evaluate, and act on Private Markets Content, defining the content strategy and feature set that makes this content an indispensable input for financial professionals — including identifying and closing content gaps, and driving adoption and usage across the client base. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to define requirements, author PRDs, and lead the development of new features. Who You Are: • An experienced Product Manager with a minimum of 2 years of experience building SaaS products in partnership with engineering and scrum teams. • Experienced in financial data and search products. • A clear, persuasive communicator who creates PRDs, roadmaps, and requirements that align stakeholders and drive execution. • Organized and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to manage a complex product backlog and deliver features end-to-end. • A strategic thinker with a discovery mindset, deeply curious about client workflows and pain points, especially those of financial analysts, investment bankers, and corporate development/deal teams. • Familiarity with AI-powered search or workflow technologies. • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field required. What You'll Do: • Define and execute the short- and mid-term roadmaps for AlphaSense's private markets, shareholder, and deals content, aligning with business objectives and client needs. • Contribute to the long-term Financial Data vision by building a deep understanding of client personas (e.g., analysts, bankers, corporate development professionals) and their diligence, deal-sourcing, and ownership-analysis use cases. • Continuously assess content gaps across private markets, shareholder, and deals data, and prioritize sourcing and coverage improvements to close them. • Write and prioritize product requirements (PRDs) informed by customer discovery and client feedback, specifically related to content coverage, data quality, and discoverability of vendor, shareholder, and deals content. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management
jobs.description: Job Description Are you ready to take your career Global? The senior manager, product management will lead product strategy, roadmap development, and product management execution for a strategic component of the Genius portfolio, one of Global Payments' flagship commerce and software platforms. The Genius portfolio powers integrated point-of-sale, digital commerce, and customer engagement experiences that help businesses serve their customers more effectively across physical and digital channels. As part of this organization, you will be responsible for a portfolio that combines foundational commerce platform capabilities with highly visible customer-facing experiences, including self-service ordering, mobile applications, web ordering, and emerging digital engagement solutions. You will lead a team of Product Managers and partner closely with Engineering, Product Delivery, UX, Sales, Customer Success, and customers to define and execute a product vision that balances platform stability, operational excellence, user experience modernization, innovation, and long-term business growth. This role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of a highly strategic product portfolio while building scalable product management practices, strengthening product discipline, and delivering market-leading customer experiences. What you'll own: Lead and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for a portfolio of point-of-sale and digital commerce products. Establish clear ownership, accountability, product management best practices, and a culture focused on customer outcomes, innovation, and execution excellence. Own the product strategy and roadmap for an integrated commerce portfolio that includes point-of-sale capabilities and customer-facing digital experiences. Define priorities based on market opportunities, customer needs, business objectives, platform health, and user experience insights. Establish and continuously improve a scalable Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) and product operating model. Build repeatable processes for discovery, research, prioritization, roadmap planning, requirements management, launch readiness, and product performance measurement. Drive the transition from a custom-request-driven roadmap toward a strategic, product-led roadmap informed by market opportunities, user needs, competitive trends, and long-term business objectives. Lead the evolution of a connected commerce ecosystem spanning point-of-sale, self-service ordering, mobile applications, web ordering, and emerging digital engagement channels. Ensure a seamless and consistent experience across all touchpoints. Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Product Delivery, and UX teams to define scalable and maintainable solutions that balance innovation, reliability, performance, and customer value. Champion user experience modernization across both operator-facing and customer-facing products. Influence design strategy and user experience decisions that improve usability, accessibility, adoption, conversion, and customer satisfaction. Lead product strategy and execution for key modernization initiatives, including mobile applications, self-service solutions, digital ordering, and next-generation commerce experiences. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders. Regularly engage with customers to understand operational challenges, gather feedback, validate product direction, and communicate roadmap strategy. Develop a structured approach for gathering market intelligence, customer insights, competitive analysis, and performance metrics. Translate findings into actionable recommendations that influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities. Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to align product investments with market opportunities and customer needs.
